app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $75, paid online.

fee_waiver.value: No graduate-school-wide fee waiver was found on the fetched pages. Lyle runs its own waiver (see its programs).

gre_general.value: The graduate school says to check department requirements; each program record gives its own GRE rule.
gre_general.quote: Official scores for the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) (check department requirements)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 (old scale), or score level 4 on the new scale from 2026.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score for admission is 80/score level 4.

english_waiver.value: The waiver covers only a U.S. degree or a listed country. India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score even with an English-medium degree.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement can only be waived if applicants have either a bachelor’s or master’s degree from a U.S. institution or a qualifying country from the list below

notes: Sources: grad.smu.edu international guide; Moody 'International Applicants' pages; Dedman international requirements page (TOEFL, IELTS, waiver list). Lyle School of Engineering runs its own admissions (lyle/apply-now and FAQ): same $75 fee and test minimums, but its own GRE rule (required for PhD) and a fee waiver for applications by October 31, 2026. The Dedman deadlines page carries an 'Update: GRE Requirement' link that points to smu.edu/moody; no matching notice was found, so GRE values for Dedman programs may change. The Dedman Data Science PhD URL listed on the Moody degrees page returns 404; the Statistics and Data Science graduate page was used instead.
